n: CMU Robotics Academy NVIDIA Jetson Curriculum
t: Two AI and robotics courses on the NVIDIA Jetson Nano with the JetBot.
steps: Find the courses on the CS2N site.
Buy a Jetson Nano developer kit and a JetBot kit.
Add a 64 GB microSD card, batteries, a monitor, a keyboard, and a mouse.
Consider the recommended USB video capture card.
Use a Windows or Mac laptop.
Open the first unit and build the robot.
